method.motion: Numerical first-order thruster response plus modest current
method.exploration: Distributed frontier scoring from measured sonar-return coverage
method.protection: Predictive threat-facing guard envelope with local separation control
method.claim_limit: Synthetic software simulation; real sensors, Gazebo physics and physical protection require separate validation.

metrics.classifier: synthetic feature/template baseline; no trained AI

checks.name: finite_bounded_commands
checks.criterion: All command components finite; speed <= 1.3 m/s.

checks.name: wildlife_clearance
checks.criterion: Synthetic wildlife and AUV surfaces stay >= 0.8 m apart.

checks.name: seabed_clearance
checks.criterion: Synthetic AUV surface stays >= 1 m above the analytic seabed.

checks.name: measured_mapping
checks.criterion: Actual sonar return endpoints populate the map; observed seabed error <= 1 m.
